request: Prove Unix socket paths remaining after two backend exit1 cannot accept connections, capture bounded sanitized startup error only; no unlink, no inference, no Docker mutation.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
v=$(docker exec -i ai-core-model-gate python3 - <<'PY'
import os,socket,stat
for n in ("granite","qwen3","ministral","coder"):
 p="/run/ai-core-backend/"+n+".sock"
 try:
  st=os.lstat(p)
  if not stat.S_ISSOCK(st.st_mode): print(n+"=UNSAFE_NOT_SOCKET");continue
  s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX,socket.SOCK_STREAM);s.settimeout(1)
  try: rc=s.connect_ex(p)
  finally: s.close()
  print(n+"=SOCKET_CONNECT_ERRNO_"+str(rc))
 except OSError as e: print(n+"=PATH_ERRNO_"+str(e.errno))
PY
)
m="AI_CORE_UDS_STALE_SOCKET_DIAG\n$v"
for n in ai-granite ai-coder; do
 x=$(docker logs --since 2026-10-16T19:15:00Z --tail 100 "$n" 2>&1 | grep -Ei 'error' | tail -1 | sed -E 's#(/[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+){2,}#<path>#g' | cut -c 1-180 || :)
 m="$m\nERROR_$n=$x"
done
printf '%b\n' "$m"
gh api -X POST repos/seigo-gace/ai-core/issues/1/comments -f body="$(printf '%b' "$m")" --jq '.html_url' >/dev/null
